name: Bone-Bound
detailed_description:
🦴 ABOUT THIS GAME

Bone-Bound is a lane-based, turn-by-turn strategy roguelite where you conquer castles, summon creatures, and build your own evolving deck of undead and allied species.

Start with skeletal forces and expand your army across 12 unique species, each with their own synergy potential, cards, and passive traits. Conquer enemy strongholds, defend your own, and uncover hidden quests through a dynamic world shrouded in fog.

⚔️ Core Features

  • Conquer the Map – Take on a series of castle battles in a roguelite progression. How many can you defeat before falling?

  • Turn-by-Turn Lane Combat – Deploy creatures in 3 strategic lanes. Timing and positioning are key to both offense and defense.

  • Card-Driven Mechanics – Build your deck with Creature, Spell, Pet, and Equipment cards. Every draw is a tactical decision.

  • Evolving Cards & Rank-Ups – Units can level up mid-run, mutate, and fuse into entirely new creatures with powerful abilities.

  • Species Synergy System – Stack passive effects and ability combos across 12 species with unique playstyles and deck archetypes.

  • Castle Defense & Upgrades – Upgrade your base with perks like Fortitude, Soul Collector, and Siege Towers.

  • D&D-Inspired Quests & Events – Take side paths to resolve fate rolls, skill checks, and dynamic encounters.

  • Fog of War – Scout ahead, secure visibility, and watch for hidden threats.

  • Customization & Unlockables – Collect deck backings, castle skins, and wisp companions tied to your progress and playstyle.

  • Pixel Art & Animation – Handcrafted visuals, expressive cards, and bouncy undead sprites.

  • Roguelite Replayability – Each run offers fresh card pulls, new event paths, and endless deck-building possibilities.

💀 For Fans Of:

Fire Emblem, Into the Breach, Slay the Spire, and pixel-art strategy games with deep customization and tactical replay value.

  • Processor: Intel Core i3 (2.0 GHz or better)
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated Graphics (Intel HD 4000 or better)
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Any

Recommended:

  • Processor: Intel Core i5 or AMD Ryzen 5
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 660 / AMD Radeon HD 7870
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 750 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Any
